scope: Declared grid for the descriptive H1-H3 estimands of lcb_ngpu_lean_theory.py. Every parameter is a scenario assumption, none is measured. The capacity rate is the energy-exclusive capital and hosting cost of one GPU hour; public rental prices are payment L only and never enter it. Version 2 adds the market-basis central capacity rate and one more grid cell between the central and the rental-parity cell.
response_fee_reading: 0 is the archived per-token tariff as listed (the preregistered reading). 0.04 is an exploratory counterfactual fixed fee per response, not an archived price.
anchor_note: Anchor ids refer to data/calibration/public-prices-2026-10-08.json. Coder and Nemotron have no durable archived tariff, so they get no bill, alpha_C or admission interval. The hidden-token rate equals the output rate (scenario assumption).
capacity_cells_note: 0.25 and 0.5: below every market-basis case, subsidised or internal rates only (the site rate lives here). 1: bottom of the H100-class range and the A100 centre. 2.4: central market-basis capacity rate of H100-class hardware per busy GPU hour (band 2.0-3.0). 3: upper part of the band. 4: rental parity cell (capacity plus electricity at or above the cheapest sustainable rental), not a capacity estimate. Source: data/calibration/public-gpu-cost-anchors-2026-10-24.json.
